# Phase One — Revelation Before Motion

The Awtsmoos renews each route before one stylesheet can harden into law;
Awtsmoos.com is the palace, and every scattered control must return to one local awe.

## Mission

Do better means no celebratory stopping after one clean component. The next wave closes unfinished Comment Thread proof, then attacks Rebbe as a layered UI system rather than a single audio defect.

## Possibility field

- Finish Comment Thread test proof from the current source/test state.
- Verify no native media controls remain there.
- Record Comment Thread closure in REMAINING_WORK only after evidence.
- Trace Rebbe player creation and player-bar rendering separately.
- Trace CSS import graph to identify which of `style.css` and `styles/*.css` actually load.
- Trace old/new duplicated selectors before editing anything.
- Replace any visible native media chrome only after proving visibility/ownership.
- Localize Rebbe controls under a route root if one already exists; otherwise add a deliberate route root contract.
- Replace inline `style=` geometry in entry HTML where ownership is obvious.
- Replace generated monolithic `<style>` strings with imported local CSS modules when safe.
- Normalize z-index into named layer tokens instead of arbitrary 500/9999/10050 escalation.
- Bound search fullscreen results to viewport + safe area.
- Ensure every modal has internal scroll rather than page escape.
- Ensure context menus clamp to viewport.
- Ensure fixed download stack cannot cover player or navigation.
- Ensure selection bar and player bar have collision-safe bottom offsets.
- Style checkboxes/ranges/colors/selects consistently inside studio only, without global leakage.
- Give file-picker triggers explicit custom visual ownership while native input remains hidden.
- Give search keyword/select controls complete focus/hover/disabled state.
- Give playlist editor fields labeled, bounded mobile layouts.
- Preserve existing behavior APIs while extracting visual ownership into smaller modules.
- Keep every touched file <=120 lines by splitting responsibilities.
- Add source contracts for native media, layer tokens, and global-selector leakage.
- Run existing Rebbe tests if present; otherwise create focused contracts around touched surfaces.
- Prefer direct observation and measured source/runtime evidence over aesthetic guesses.

## Initial work graph

Comment Thread proof -> durable ledger -> Rebbe import graph -> player ownership -> overlay/layer map -> form-control ownership -> code-first wave -> tests -> route-load proof -> delta review -> next route.
